'''Indigo tourmaline''' is one of the higher value [[gem]]s (semi-precious) that can be found within [[sedimentary]] and [[metamorphic]] stone layers, as well as within [[granite]]. Scoring a x25 multiplier, the same as [[clear zircon]], these are great for saving for later when you have great gem-cutters and gem-setters to get very high value objects.
